_: A snapshot of the design system's light-theme tokens, taken from
Design/_base.css in the brain folder. It lives here because CI cannot
read that folder — the mockups are not in this repository — and a
comparison nobody can run is a comparison that stops being true.
CAMP-217: twelve tokens had silently failed to arrive, and nothing
noticed because nothing compared. Values are already public: every one
of them ships in globals.css on the live site.
Dark-theme values are deliberately not here. The two files disagree on
them by design — ours are tuned per token — and snapshotting them would
turn a decision into a failure.
